title: Titans CEO Burke Nihill: Our organization believes in coach Robert Saleh, GM Mike Borgonzi

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Titans CEO Burke Nihill: Our organization believes in coach Robert Saleh, GM Mike Borgonzi
sources.description: The Titans have fired a head coach or GM each of the last four years, but they say they're going to be patient with their current coach and GM.
